steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 12
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: The music festival happens every summer.
Everyone stood for the national anthem.
This holiday is celebrated with fireworks.

steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
